no_adcom_quote.quote: We chose not to convene an advisory committee to evaluate this NDA.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for the Rexulti (brexpiprazole) NDA205422 approval. Two FDA review documents explicitly state this: the Office/Division Director memo (ODMemo L119) says the Division chose not to convene an AC because, although brexpiprazole is a new molecular entity, there was nothing novel about the drug, the studies were conventionally designed with clear clinical benefit, and there were no unique safety issues; the Medical Review (MedR L1348) similarly states the product would not be presented at an Advisory Committee. Because no committee met, there are no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval.
